summary.problem: /privacy slash command fails with 'Error loading Opt-in settings: User does not have a current tier' when logged in with Google Account + GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT.
summary.root_cause: In usePrivacySettings.ts, the getTier function throws an Error when loadCodeAssist response does not contain currentTier, instead of inspecting allowedTiers or treating missing tier as non-free tier.
summary.context: For licensed accounts using GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT, loadCodeAssist response may leave currentTier undefined. When getTier throws an exception, usePrivacySettings sets the error state instead of setting isFreeTier to false to show the paid privacy notice.

steps: Modify getTier in packages/cli/src/ui/hooks/usePrivacySettings.ts to safely resolve the user tier when res.currentTier is not defined.
In getTier, check if res.currentTier exists; if not, check res.allowedTiers for a default tier or fall back to UserTierId.LEGACY instead of throwing an error.
Ensure usePrivacySettings sets isFreeTier to false when the user tier is not UserTierId.FREE.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When loadCodeAssist returns a response without currentTier, usePrivacySettings sets isFreeTier to false without error.
verification_steps: Add unit tests in packages/cli/src/ui/hooks/usePrivacySettings.test.ts for usePrivacySettings.
Mock CodeAssistServer.loadCodeAssist to return a response with currentTier as undefined.
Verify that privacyState has isLoading: false, error: undefined, and isFreeTier: false.
